But peace is shattered when Mike Dormer arrives as a guest at her aunt's hotel. Mike, the sophisticated English gentleman with elegant attire and troubled eyes, threatens to dismantle everything Liza has worked so hard to protect: not just the family business and the whale-watching haven she loves, but also her belief that she can never love againâthat she doesn't deserve to love at all.

For Mike, the stakes are different. He expects only a business arrangement, yet he discovers an eccentric community and an enigmatic woman whose presence changes his life forever. *Silver Bay* is a wonderfully emotional and surprising story of unexpected connection in a picturesque setting.
